edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25. The copyright leaf prints 'Copyright, 1888, by Clarence E. Woodman' with a Library of Congress copyright stamp of 23 December 1889; the approval leaf carries the approval of James Cardinal Gibbons, Archbishop of Baltimore and Apostolic Delegate, Baltimore, 17 May 1889, and the imprimatur of Michael Augustinus Corrigan, Archbishop of New York. The 1888 United States copyright has expired and the printing is public domain in the United States; its printed 'All rights reserved' notice is a lapsed nineteenth-century claim. Consulted through page images of the Internet Archive exemplar manualofprayersf00wood; no exact artifact has been registered.

work.author: Third Plenary Council of Baltimore
work.description: The lay prayer book ordered by the Third Plenary Council of Baltimore (1884) and approved by James Cardinal Gibbons on 17 May 1889, companion to the Baltimore catechisms. It prints the ordinary prayers, the seasonal Marian antiphons of Compline in Latin and English, and a full method of reciting the Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary with a meditation and a petition for each of the fifteen traditional mysteries. Cited by printed page.
work.title: A Manual of Prayers for the Use of the Catholic Laity, Prepared and Published by Order of the Third Plenary Council of Baltimore
